class.name: ShapeQuery3DDirect
class.brief_description: Queries the world for physics objects that intersect with a shape.
class.description: [admonition type="note" collapsible="true" open="false"] [b]Part of [i]Godot Engine: Conservatory Edition[/i].[/b] This is not available in the official build of Godot. [/admonition] Queries the world for physics objects that intersect with a shape. This is a more optimized alternative to [ShapeCast3DDirect], at the cost that the shape can [b]not[/b] be moving (there is no [code]motion[/code] field).

method.name: query
method.description: Performs a query using the properties of this object as parameters, in the provided physics [param space]. Can return up to [param max_count] results. Returns the amount of objects that were actually hit, to read from [member results].

method.name: query_statically
method.description: Perform a query without having to make a new instance of [ShapeQuery3DDirect], using the provided [param parameters], in the provided physics [param space]. Can return up to [param max_count] items.

method.name: query_statically_preallocated
method.description: Statically perform a query using the provided [param parameters]. This variation of the method is special in that it expects the passed array ([param result_preallocated]) to have its size set [b]before[/b] calling this method. The size of this array is used to determine the number of results. This variation of the method is most optimal, as any instances of results in the array will be overwritten, instead of an entirely new result object being created. The array passed in is obviously edited; it is your result array. The return value is the amount of results actually placed into the array.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics areas (like [Area3D]) will be reported.
If [code]true[/code], collisions with physics bodies (like [PhysicsBody3D]) will be reported.

The query's collision mask. Only objects in at least one collision layer enabled in the mask will be detected. See [url=$DOCS_URL/tutorials/physics/physics_introduction.html#collision-layers-and-masks]Collision layers and masks[/url] in the documentation for more information.
Determines if [member filter] is a whitelist or blacklist for [RID]s.
If [code]true[/code], the last call to [method query] hit something.
The brim added to the outside of the shape, which gives it additional thickness.
The maximum amount of results that the instance is allowed to return. Once this many physics objects are detected, it will stop searching.
The amount of results that were collected in the last call to [method query].
All of the results that were located by the last call to [method query].
The RID of the [Shape3D] that is being used for the test.
The location of the shape in space. Note that scaling this transform is not advised; prefer setting the size properties of the shape.
